### Where to Turn When Your Thoughts Go Dark
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-25-2025.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 27:1
Points:
- Despite experiencing God's deliverance many times, David gave in to despair and convinced himself that Saul would kill him.
- Allowing dark and fearful thoughts to go unchecked led David to seek safety among enemy Philistines.
- Unwise thinking inevitably leads to compromised actions, resulting in deception and complicated dilemmas.
- Believers frequently need to be saved from their own downward spirals of thought and poor choices.
- God's steadfast kindness and mercy in Christ are never exhausted, even when our thoughts stray into darkness.

### David Deceives Achish
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-deceives-achish
Passage: 1 Samuel 27:1-28:2
Points:
- Seeking refuge among the Philistines indicated a potential lapse of faith after God had repeatedly preserved David in Israel.
- From his base in Ziklag, David raided Israelite enemies while falsely telling King Achish he was attacking Judah.
- David's craftiness gained Achish's trust but eventually trapped him in a precarious dilemma regarding upcoming battles.
- Although David's conduct was questionable, God still used David's actions to weaken Israel's adversaries.
- God is sovereign enough to bring good outcomes out of human failures and complicated situations.
